environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4). The NLB performs TCP passthrough with no inspection. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy in front of the application. The application runs as written with Gunicorn, binding to 0.0.0.0:8080. SQLite database at /var/data/users.db contains production user records including emails and roles.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no content inspection)
